subject: Pilot top-up & split-credit packaging for Lumen Labs
messages:
From: Ada Morris <ada@lumenlabs.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2028-11-29T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Pilot top-up ask + packaging question

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the quick demo yesterday — excited about what Redwood can give us for Lumen's ML inference burst needs. We ran the numbers internally and have a small ask while we finalize a pilot order: would Redwood consider a hybrid concession where ~25k in promotional credits are issued up-front and we take a 15% early-conversion discount on the first month of Dedicated if we convert within 90 days?

Two constraints from our side: 1) the credits need to be usable across two teams (research + product) and 2) our procurement/legal team prefers a short SOW amendment rather than changing the contract itself. I attached a one-page SOW draft to show scope and timing. (attachment: LumenPilot_SOW_v1.pdf (pdf))

If you need a forecast of token consumption to price the Dedicated discount, I can pull that together by EOD tomorrow. Appreciate any flexibility — this pilot will determine whether we scale to a larger committed pool.

Best,
Ada Morris
Head of AI Partnerships
Lumen Labs
ada@lumenlabs.com
(attachment: LumenPilot_SOW_v1.pdf)

From: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ada Morris <ada@lumenlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-11-29T14:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot top-up ask + packaging question

Hi Ada — great to meet you yesterday, and thanks for the SOW.

We can support a hybrid structure like you describe, but need internal sign-off on two items: how the promotional credits map to seats/teams (we typically gate credits per project to reduce abuse) and the accounting treatment for the Dedicated onboarding discount. I've looped in Marissa (pricing) and Neha (contracts/procurement) to confirm the operational approach.

Two quick asks from our side:
- Can you share a short weekly token forecast (product vs research) so we can draft the conversion mechanics?
- Can the SOW stay scoped to a 60-day pilot with a simple conversion path to Dedicated to keep legal comfortable?

If we get those two items, I expect Marissa can greenlight the credit amount and Neha can draft an SOW amendment. Will update by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive — Startups & Accelerators
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com

Date: 2028-11-30T09:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot top-up ask + packaging question

Kimberly / Neha — quick thoughts from pricing:

- Approved in principle for a hybrid split, conditional on a token forecast and a cap on cross-team usage. Recommend structuring as: 30,000 promotional credits usable across two projects with per-project sub-allocations (example: 20k product / 10k research).
- If Lumen converts to Dedicated within 90 days, provide a 20% one-time onboarding discount (applied to first month committed spend) rather than an ongoing percent reduction — easier for accounting and preserves long-term ARR math.
- Need credits_breakdown.xlsx with example amortization and revenue recognition notes for finance; I attached a working sheet. (attachment: credits_breakdown.xlsx (xlsx))

If Neha is good on the SOW amendment language, let's send an updated SOW + the DocuSign link and get signatures.

Marissa
Director, Pricing & Packaging
Redwood Inference
(attachment: credits_breakdown.xlsx)

From: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ada Morris <ada@lumenlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-12-01T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot top-up ask + packaging question — updated SOW and next steps

Hi Ada — good news: pricing has approved a slightly tweaked split and legal has a short SOW amendment ready. Summary of the agreed commercial terms below: 

- Promo credits: 30,000 free promo credits apportioned 20,000 (product) / 10,000 (research)
- Conversion incentive: 20% one-time onboarding credit applied to first month of Dedicated if converted within 90 days of pilot start
- Pilot window: 60 days; credits expire at the end of the pilot unless conversion occurs per the above clause

I've attached an updated SOW (Updated_SOW_Lumen_v2.pdf) and included the DocuSign link to execute the SOW amendment: https://www.docusign.com/s/abc123-Lumen-SOW. Please confirm the token forecast when you have it and we'll attach it as Exhibit A.

If that sounds good, we'll route the DocuSign to your legal contact (accounts@lumenlabs.com) and expedite provisioning so your teams can start the pilot next week.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive — Startups & Accelerators
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
(attachment: Updated_SOW_Lumen_v2.pdf)
